cause.root_cause_summary: Re-polling a trigger that has already twice reported no real-world change adds nothing; the actual new information this run is that the SSI phases themselves (S1..S11) are now real Experience records in their own right, and E12's method had never been re-run over them to see whether they form any new repeated shape.

lesson: When a real trigger goes dormant, the correct move is not to keep re-checking it -- it is to redirect the same honest detection method at a part of the real data that has actually grown since it was last checked, and to exclude everything already known (by grouping key, not just by description text) before calling anything 'new'.
